title: Add reconciliation tracing targets to alert guidance
description: Host target refusals during lifecycle and stale-host-charge reconciliation warn on syrup_rail::gateway_lifecycle_reconciliation and syrup_rail::host_charge_reconciliation, while operator guidance currently names only the direct syrup_rail::host_charge_target warning target.
acceptance_criteria: Public operator guidance names both reconciliation warning targets and explains that refused transitions leave financial attempts or evidence unresolved.

title: Rehearse peak account-mode verification query throttling
description: Validate peak-batch rather than steady-state NMI account-mode query volume. A verification-query rate limit terminalizes the in-flight attempt and starts a provider-wide cooldown, so the failure curve is intentionally fail-closed but cliff-shaped.
acceptance_criteria: Load rehearsal covers peak renewal and foreground mutation volume, records NMI query headroom, and verifies alert thresholds before provider-wide cooldown activation.

title: Evaluate migration affordance for test-mode entitlement defaults
description: EntitlementQuery::new and EntitlementGuard::new now default to live subscriptions without a signature change. The changelog and type docs cover test deployments; evaluate whether a stronger migration affordance is useful.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm documentation is sufficient or add a non-breaking diagnostic/example that makes accidental live defaults visible to test deployments.

title: Decide repository policy for Beads tracker exports
description: The configured .beads workspace and newly created review follow-ups are currently untracked. Decide which metadata and JSONL export belong in version control while keeping database and WAL files ignored.
acceptance_criteria: Repository policy explicitly states whether .beads/issues.jsonl, config, and metadata are committed, and git ignores local database artifacts.

title: Replace or constrain the schema index SQL splitter
description: The v4 test helper deliberately splits an artifact containing two simple CREATE INDEX statements on semicolons and now asserts the count. A future procedural block or embedded semicolon would fail misleadingly; either keep the artifact contract explicit or use a statement-aware executor.
acceptance_criteria: The helper documents and enforces a simple-statement-only artifact, or executes future SQL containing embedded semicolons correctly.

title: Add host adapter release exact-replay integration gate
description: Add a host-owned integration test for HostChargeTargetStore that durably applies ReleasedBeforeSubmission during ordinary cooldown pacing and returns ExactReplay for the same attempt without duplicating audit or state transitions. The crate documents this as a host release gate, but generic library tests cannot prove each deployment adapter.
acceptance_criteria: A deployment-level test exercises first application and exact replay of ReleasedBeforeSubmission on the same database transaction boundary and proves repeat-safe ensure_submission_admitted behavior.

title: Normalize renewal gateway-mode decode errors
description: renewal.rs maps an invalid persisted gateway mode through sqlx::Error::ColumnDecode and RenewalStoreError::Sql, while other decoders classify the same invariant as domain invalid state. Align the boundary or document why renewal intentionally differs.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid required_gateway_account_mode storage has a consistent, tested public error classification across renewal, subscription persistence, and entitlement reads.

title: Verify NotTransmitted transport and NMI replay assumptions
description: Validate that the supported reqwest/hyper versions keep reqwest::Error::is_connect() limited to failures before the mutation can reach NMI, and verify duplicate-order-id suppression for deployed merchant accounts. Existing tests cover connection refusal as known-not-submitted and an established HTTP/1 reset as indeterminate; this task tracks dependency-upgrade and deployment verification rather than a confirmed defect.
acceptance_criteria: Document the supported dependency contract, add or retain transport classification coverage for pre-connect versus established-connection failures, and record merchant-account order-ID replay behavior.

title: Document prepared versus terminal enrollment admission rejection
description: SubscriptionEnrollmentSubmissionOutcome::Rejected carries a still-prepared attempt for GatewayAccountModeChanged but terminal failed attempts for the other rejection reasons. The typed reason and public-api guide state the distinction, but the enum variant itself does not.
acceptance_criteria: Add API-local documentation or a semver-appropriate outcome shape that makes the retry ownership of GatewayAccountModeChanged unmistakable without weakening the prepared-attempt behavior.

title: Evaluate steady-state cost of the mandatory mode renewal index
description: Schema v4 requires billing_subscriptions_due_mode_idx even for live-only hosts using the all-mode renewal API. Those deployments maintain two similar partial indexes whenever next_payment_attempt_at changes.
acceptance_criteria: Measure renewal write and index-storage cost for representative live-only and mixed-mode datasets, then document the accepted overhead or revise the schema contract with a safe compatibility plan.

title: Clarify staged outcome versus newly-staged summary naming
description: GatewayLifecycleApplyOutcome::staged_count counts staged classifications while GatewayLifecycleReconciliationSummary::staged counts newly inserted pending rows. Documentation is correct, but the shared staged naming can mislead callers.
acceptance_criteria: Assess a semver-appropriate naming or accessor strategy and keep classification count distinct from newly persisted row count.

title: Evaluate pacing for wrong-mode all-mode renewal dispatch
description: An unfiltered renewal scanner routed to a mode-specific service repeatedly rediscovers wrong-mode subscriptions because GatewayAccountModeChanged does not advance next_payment_attempt_at. Routing by RenewalDispatch mode is documented; evaluate whether an additional pacing or operator signal is warranted.
acceptance_criteria: Document the intentional routing-only contract or implement a bounded pacing/operator signal that cannot hide correctly routed work.
